description:
The making of my Jack Sparrow inspired ice cream, it's FULL of Rum and I mean FULL OF RUM!

Why is the rum always gone?

Right from the get go......... If you don't like Rum, you won't like this ice cream.   You can obviously exchange the rum for whatever booze you want BUT...... not all alcohol is created equally. Strength (ABV/Proof) of the alcohol has a huge impact on the resulting ice cream. 
One great thing about using alcohol in ice cream is that you can reduce the sugars but guess what.... alcohol also has sugar in it 😉

So with that in mind, let's get to the making of the ice cream. 

What you'll need for the ice cream base:

356g Heavy/Double Cream
451g Milk (2% or Semi Skimmed)
84g Skimmed Milk Powder
80g Egg Yolk (3 medium yolks ish)
180g Sugar
50g Lambs Rum (30% ABV or 60 Proof so technically a rum based drink)
2g Stabiliser blend


Sparrows Rum Caramel:
225g sugar
60g water
71g room temp butter
125g cream
80g Sparrows rum (40% ABV or 80 Proof)


Gunpowder Rum chocolate truffles:
100g double cream
25g salted butter, cubed
300g milk chocolate, finely chopped
50ml Pusser's Gunpowder Proof Rum (54.5% ABV or 109 Proof)
Coating:  2-3 tbsp cocoa powder

The individual parts to this combo are really good, the ice cream isn't too strong alcohol wise so most people should be fine with it. The problem for them will be when you add the caramel and truffles. It is at this point, there's so much rum going on, only hardened ice creamers and or drinkers will want to eat it. 
With that in mind, you can have the caramel sauce and truffles "on the side" and then people can add them if they wish.
